top_signals.title: Castleberry-Hernandez: Saudi Action on Houthis Into 2027
top_signals.summary: Oil edged higher as risks of a new round of US strikes on Iran is growing as military clashes intensified and diplomatic efforts remain stalled. Asha Castleberry-Hernandez, Adjunct Fellow at the American Security Project and former senior official for Near Eastern Affairs at the US State Department under the Biden-Harris administration spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
